{{Quote|Crab droids have a subpar targeting percentage, but deliver a profit of forty-eight-thousand credits per unit. They might not win the war, but they could save the Techno Union's fiscal quarter.|Techno Union risk-assessment report|<ref name="NEGD" />}}
The '''LM-432 crab droid''', also simply referred to as a '''crab droid''', was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its name was derived from its six-legged scuttling movement and organic appearance, though it belonged to the [[spider droid family]]. These droids were also nicknamed "'''muckrackers'''" because of their extensive use in marshy terrain.

==Characteristics==
[[File:LM-432CrabDroid-TCW.png|thumb|left|200px|A crab droid poised to strike with a front leg.]]
Ranging from three to twenty feet tall, the crab droid could use its legs to attack infantry in its way. As well as their powerful pincer legs, LM-432 crab [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were armed with twin [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] located on the bottom of the droid's body. These blasters were capable of rapid fire and a powerful double blast. They were also equipped with a vacuum pump system integrated into their forward pincers, which could suck up and then spit out mud to either clear space for Separatist forces or obscure the visual [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] of enemy forces. This earned them the nickname of "muckracker".<ref name="NEGD" /> Crab droids also used their front two pincers to whack opponents out of the way or to crush them with their ends. The crab droid was also equipped with three glowing [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] eyes and communication/sensor antennae&mdash;making it seem like it was a living creature rather than a machine&mdash;a feature many of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatists' droids]] included.

LM-432 units were protected by [[Armorplast/Legends|armorplast]]-shielding that could deflect blaster shots. The largest legs of an LM-432 unit were tipped with heavy [[Duranium/Legends|duranium]] stabilizers that could secure perches on even bedrock. Smaller LM-432s were unable to rid themselves of opponents who got on top of them&mdash;veteran clones knew to avoid their [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] by leaping on top of them. When in pursuit of an enemy, it could move very fast in short bursts to overtake it, and in this way run over their target.

==History==
[[File:Crabdroid_bg.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A clone trooper destroys a crab droid during the Battle of Utapau.]]

Crab droids were first deployed in conflicts on marshy worlds, but their ability to cross difficult terrain and even scale jagged surfaces led to their usage elsewhere, such as at the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].

Other variants of the LM-432 crab droid included tiny models for espionage and giant versions that served as mobile armor, which were capable of taking on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. One rare variant was equipped with [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Bubble wort projector/Legends|bubble wort projectors]] that could imprison their targets in force fields.

[[File:Force_Bubbles_Battle.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Modified crab droids equipped with bubble wort projectors were deployed against a team of Jedi.]]

At least one crab droid was seen fighting on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|Mission to Rodia]].<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref>
Also, a large number of them were used in the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], but nearly all were destroyed by the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]].

They were also heavily used as security in the Separatist prison, [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]]. Many were used because of the rough terrain, to capture the Jedi who attempted escape.

Following the execution of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], these units were deactivated.

[[File:WinduRidesAgain-TCWRHPrima.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Mace Windu impales a four legged crab droid while riding its back]]
A number of them were used by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Vril Vrakth]] during the [[Battle of Nizon]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="FtS" />

Tens of thousands of crab droids were seized<ref name="NEGD" /> from Techno Union factories<ref name="CRA 1-2">{{FactFile2014|27|CRA 1-2|LM-432 Crab Droid}}</ref> by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Tar Morden]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which were eventually used in live-fire [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] training exercises<ref name="NEGD" /> at the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. Others used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and sentries during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CRA 1-2" /> [[Caridan (species)|Caridan]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] drew upon their experience with crab droids in developing the [[Mountain Terrain Armored Transport]] "[[Spider/Legends|spider]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]]" after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="NEGD" />
